summary: Iteration-3 testing of the roles/consultations batch + auto-scan changes. Backend: 56/56 pytest cases pass (20 legacy test_backend.py, 10 test_new_features.py, 26 NEW test_roles_consults.py). Verified super_admin-by-email on /api/auth/me, plain-user role, RBAC 403 for user on /api/admin/*, 401 unauthenticated, derm register -> pending + role flip, /derm/me, pending NOT in public /dermatologists, admin pending list, approve/reject/re-approve, public list omits meeting_link and _id, 404 on unknown derm, super_admin-only /admin/users, promote user->admin (then admin can hit /admin/dermatologists but not /admin/users), demote, 400 on changing super admin, 400 on invalid role, 404 unknown target. Appointments: request -> 'requested' (no link), 404 on unknown derm, list split as_patient/as_dermatologist, 403 when patient tries confirm/decline, derm confirm -> status confirmed + meeting_link revealed and visible to patient, patient cancel, derm decline (no link), 404 on unknown appt id, 401 unauthenticated. Auto-scan /api/scan re-verified with 6 real hair photos through gpt-5.6-terra: frames_used now equals frames_analyzed (6/6 and 9/9) confirming all non-blurry frames are averaged (BLUR_QUALITY_MIN=40); region persistence + invalid-region fallback + 400 on unusable payload still pass. Frontend (seeded session cookies, 4 role personas): Navbar role gating correct (Consult for all, Practice only for dermatologist, Admin only for admin/super_admin), /dermatologists lists only approved derms (pending derm absent), request-dialog + appt-datetime + appt-note + appt-submit works and creates a 'Requested' row, /derm shows approved status + incoming request and confirm-{id} flips to 'Meet link', patient then sees 'Confirmed' + Join button pointing at the derm's Google Meet link, /derm registration form (derm-name/derm-specialty/derm-meeting_link/derm-save-btn) submits and switches to pending status with Practice nav appearing, /admin as super_admin shows Dermatologists tab (approve-{uid} removes the pending row) and Users tab (promote/demote round-trip, no buttons rendered for super_admin rows), plain user on /admin gets the 'Admins only' guard. Upload auto-scan UI: region-full/crown/hairline present, start-scan-btn label reflects duration (30s / 24s / 24s), hint text reflects photo count (~30 / ~13), torch-toggle + torch-btn present and toggle state (Flash off -> Flash on). Real 30s camera capture not exercised (headless) per instructions.

minor.issue: An already-APPROVED dermatologist can edit name/specialty/meeting_link and keeps status 'approved' (no re-review). A bad actor could get approved with a clean profile and then swap in an arbitrary meeting link/name. Consider resetting to 'pending' (or flagging) when meeting_link/name/specialty change.

Promoting a user whose current role is 'dermatologist' to 'admin' silently destroys the dermatologist role while their approved dermatologist_profile stays public and can still receive appointments; the Navbar 'Practice' link then disappears so they cannot manage requests from the UI. Either block role changes for dermatologists or keep derm capability independent of the role field.

Users are looked up by exact-case email with no unique index on users.email; DB currently holds TWO docs with email iampandasubham@gmail.com (both super_admin). Normalize email to lowercase and add a unique index.
Returns up to 2000 users with no pagination/search; will not scale and the /admin Users tab renders all of them in one list.
STILL OPEN from iteration_2: model_dump() writes unset fields as null, so a partial update wipes age/gender/hair_type/goals. Use exclude_unset=True.
STILL OPEN from iteration_2: manual analyze does not carry `region` onto the analysis doc, so the Results region-badge disappears after a manual re-analyze of a scan session.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale copy: 'Auto-scan sweeps ~30s of frames and reports on the 3-4 most confident.' The backend now averages ALL non-blurry frames, and the toast/other copy says otherwise. Misleading to users.

issues: Uses the browser-native <input type="datetime-local"> picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/time control used elsewhere in the design system - inconsistent look and no validation that the requested time is in the future (a past date can be submitted).
Flat unpaginated, unsearchable list; role badge + single action button only. Fine now, unusable at scale.

action_items: Fix stale Upload.jsx subtitle (line 372) to describe the new all-non-blurry-frames averaging instead of 'the 3-4 most confident'.
Decide behaviour for approved derms editing their profile (re-review vs keep approved) - currently meeting_link can be changed post-approval with no re-check.
Guard role changes for dermatologist accounts (promoting a derm to admin orphans their approved profile and hides the Practice nav).
Lowercase-normalize users.email + add a unique index (duplicate super_admin docs already exist in test_database).
Carry over the two still-open iteration_2 items: POST /profile partial-update wipe, and region not persisted by /sessions/{id}/analyze.
Optional: replace the native datetime-local input in the appointment dialog with the shadcn calendar + reject past times.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py derm_register: preserves `status` on update, so an approved derm silently re-writes meeting_link/name without re-approval. Add re-review trigger.

server.py admin_set_role: only validates the target role value, not the target's current role; dermatologist -> admin breaks the derm UX invariant (Navbar gates /derm on role === 'dermatologist' while dermatologist_profiles stays approved).
server.py auth_session: db.users.find_one({'email': email}) is case-sensitive and there is no unique index on email -> duplicate accounts (already reproduced: 2 docs for iampandasubham@gmail.com).
server.py admin_list_derms returns raw profile docs including email + meeting_link; admin-only so acceptable, but consider a projection to keep the contract explicit.

server.py finalize_day_analysis: `usable if usable else frames` means if EVERY frame is blurry, all blurry frames are averaged and the client still gets confident-looking scores with no flag. Consider returning frames_rejected / a low-quality warning.

Frontend Admin.jsx renders users without pagination; DermPractice.jsx defines the `Field` component inside render (remounts on each keystroke-driven re-render) - it works today but is a re-render/focus-loss risk; typing was verified OK in the test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (roles nav gating, consult booking, derm confirm, admin approve/promote, derm registration, auto-scan UI). Live 30s camera capture not runnable headless.

seed_data_creation: test_roles_consults.py seeds its own users per run (super_admin by email iampandasubham@gmail.com, plain user, derm) and deletes them in teardown. seed_ui.py seeded 5 UI personas (patient/dermok/dermpending/superadmin/fresh) + tokens into /app/test_reports/ui_seed.json; ALL of these users, their derm profiles and appointments were deleted after the UI run. NOTE: pre-existing non-TEST leftovers from the main agent's own curl testing remain in test_database: users drjane_2ab0@ex.com (approved dermatologist 'Dr Jane', visible in the public list), patient_afe3@ex.com, selftest-1786178361@ex.com, uiqa+1786176230997@example.com (role admin), and a duplicate iampandasubham@gmail.com user - clean these before shipping.
test_credentials: No passwords - seed users + session_token in MongoDB test_database per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; auth via session_token cookie or Bearer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_roles_consults.py for RBAC/appointments (self-contained, xdist-safe: each class seeds its own derm because pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope so class order is not guaranteed - do NOT share a single derm across classes). Use /app/backend/tests/seed_ui.py to regenerate UI personas (/app/test_reports/ui_seed.json) then set the session_token cookie per persona with page.context.add_cookies (clear_cookies between personas). test_new_features.py now asserts frames_used == frames_analyzed (all non-blurry frames averaged). Remaining unverified: live camera auto-scan (headless-impossible) and the two carried-over iteration_2 backend items.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking defects. Initial 4 failures in my new test file were a TEST isolation problem (two classes shared one module-scoped derm user under xdist loadscope, so the derm was already approved before the pending assertions ran) - fixed by giving TestDermatologistLifecycle its own seeded derm; not a product bug. All product-level findings are minor/hardening items listed above.
